grade_rationale: 2 P1 security CVEs (proxy-addr CVSS 9.1, protobufjs CVSS 9.8) push below B threshold (max_p1: 0). 7 P2 findings within C limit (max_p2: 15). Spec coverage 97% on active in-flight work (26% nominal including roadmap specs).

escalations.title: proxy-addr IPv4-mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing — Authentication Bypass
escalations.exploit_scenario: Network-adjacent attacker sends IPv4-mapped IPv6 address to bypass IP-based access controls

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution — Orchestrator RCE
escalations.exploit_scenario: Crafted protobuf message from compromised gRPC client triggers RCE on Orchestrator host

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read
escalations.exploit_scenario: Vitest UI server in CI allows attacker to read .env files and secrets if --ui flag used

escalations.title: React Router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URL
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts a link with protocol-relative URL that redirects users to malicious site

escalations.title: @grpc/grpc-js Certificate Validation Bypass + Crash
escalations.exploit_scenario: MITM attacker presents unauthorized TLS certificate accepted by grpc-js
